PMID:16780588.access_scope: Selected normal full Methods, authentic publisher Table 1 and Figure 4 pixels were inspected in the independent localization consultation.
PMID:16780588.biological_scope: The exact CLDN14 supplement row reports ER/PM for the human NM_012130/AAG60052 ORF in HEK293T cells; Figure 4 shows ER-marker overlap. This is tagged overexpression localization, not a demonstrated ER-specific function.

external_source.scope: Actual publisher supplement and image authenticated in independent consultation.

PMID:32296183.access_scope: Selected full normal Methods/Results and 9 exact positive human interaction records were inspected.
PMID:32296183.biological_scope: Exact positive CLDN14 pairs with MAL, CTXN3 and PLLP occur in three two-hybrid configurations each. Pairwise retesting and sequence verification support the screen records; native tissue mechanisms are not established for these pairs.

PMID:36115835.access_scope: Selected full normal holdup Methods/Results and 61 exact positive target records were inspected; no claim that all constructs were purified full-length proteins.
PMID:36115835.biological_scope: The human CLDN14 terminal ten-residue peptide binds specific PDZ-domain fragments in holdup assays. The literal records resolve 20 partners and 61 positives; domain preparations and fragment assays do not establish all full-length native complexes.

PMID:7644498.access_scope: All five authentic original PMC page images, journal pages 7819–7823, were visually read. The exact main abstract remains unchanged.
PMID:7644498.biological_scope: The complete original paper identifies YAP WW-domain binding to WBP proline-rich ligands using fusion-protein and mutational assays. It does not support the CLDN14 tight-junction assembly attribution.

external_source.scope: All five original pages visually read, including Methods, Results, Discussion and figures. No CLDN14 assay is present.

PMID:22373575.access_scope: Selected full normal Methods/Results and Discussion were read; the construct accessions explicitly distinguish mouse CLDN14 from human CLDN16/19.
PMID:22373575.biological_scope: Mouse CLDN14 associates with human CLDN16 in membrane two-hybrid and coimmunoprecipitation assays and reduces cation permeability in LLC-PK1 models. Mouse renal expression responds to calcium-sensing regulation; the older oligomer interpretation is retained at that assay scope.

PMID:41325524.access_scope: Selected full normal Methods/Results/Discussion and the authentic supplement Constructs section were read; construct species is unspecified there.
PMID:41325524.biological_scope: CLDN14 forms a barrier in claudin-deficient MDCKII cells and participates in CLDN19-containing strands that replace CLDN16. Tagged cell models distinguish cis/trans organization, and mouse kidney studies support changing junctional composition. The inspected supplement does not identify the CLDN14 transgene species.

external_source.locator: Constructs, original supplement page 14; extracted lines 299–329
external_source.scope: Synthetic tagged CLDN14 construct described without species or accession. Heterologous host species does not identify the transgene.

PMID:12913076.access_scope: Complete authentic normal abstract read; full article not recovered.
PMID:12913076.biological_scope: The authentic abstract reports deafness and hair-cell degeneration in Cldn14-null mice, alongside increased epithelial resistance and reduced cation permeability after claudin-14 expression. These phenotypes contextualize the barrier without creating a separate developmental process assertion.

PMID:11163249.access_scope: Complete authentic normal abstract read; accessible publisher snippets do not substitute for full assay Methods.
PMID:11163249.biological_scope: The authentic abstract identifies CLDN14 mutations in recessive human deafness and reports mouse inner-ear expression. It does not supply a fully inspected human protein assay.

PMID:10508613.access_scope: Complete authentic normal abstract read. Publisher full text/PDF recovery failed; a same-title thesis-abstract record was excluded as full journal evidence.
PMID:10508613.biological_scope: The authentic abstract reports calcium-independent cell aggregation for claudin-1, -2 and -3 transfectants. Current mouse Cldn2 GOA contains the direct adhesion annotation; full assay Methods remain inaccessible.

PMID:10562289.access_scope: Selected full normal Methods/Results independently read for the actual Cldn2 donor experiments.
PMID:10562289.biological_scope: Selected full Methods and Results establish claudin-2 homopolymers and paired strands in mouse L cells, with selective heterotypic compatibility. These are donor-family experiments, not direct human CLDN14 assays.

PMID:17130295.access_scope: Selected original author-uploaded indexed Methods and Results, including source cDNAs and localization/strand observations, were read. The protected main abstract remains unchanged; no original figure pixels were inspected.
PMID:17130295.biological_scope: Endogenous CLDN14 is restricted to an apical subdomain of mammalian cochlear junctions. Mouse organ-of-Corti cDNA-derived GFP-claudin-14 forms parallel fibrils in COS-7 cells without recruiting the tested catenins; the native opposing-cell partner remains unresolved.

external_source.scope: Selected original article text from author-uploaded journal copy; mouse cDNA constructs and endogenous mammalian localization remain distinct.

PMID:15880785.access_scope: Complete authentic normal abstract read; publisher/repository routes did not yield full Methods.
PMID:15880785.biological_scope: The authentic abstract reports that wild-type claudin-14 forms tight junctions in L-M fibroblasts whereas deafness-associated V85D and G101R variants fail in distinct ways. Full Methods and exact construct-product mapping were not recovered.

definition.text: A lipid bilayer along with all the proteins and protein complexes embedded in it and attached to it.
The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a complex.
Binding to a PDZ domain of a protein, a domain found in diverse signaling proteins.

The irregular network of unit membranes, visible only by electron microscopy, that occurs in the cytoplasm of many eukaryotic cells. The membranes form a complex meshwork of tubular channels, which are often expanded into slitlike cavities called cisternae. The ER takes two forms, rough (or granular), with ribosomes adhering to the outer surface, and smooth (with no ribosomes attached).
The membrane surrounding a cell that separates the cell from its external environment. It consists of a phospholipid bilayer and associated proteins.
Binding to an identical protein or proteins.

An occluding cell-cell junction that is composed of a branching network of sealing strands that completely encircles the apical end of each cell in an epithelial sheet; the outer leaflets of the two interacting plasma membranes are seen to be tightly apposed where sealing strands are present. Each sealing strand is composed of a long row of transmembrane adhesion proteins embedded in each of the two interacting plasma membranes.
The attachment of one cell to another cell via adhesion molecules that do not require the presence of calcium for the interaction.
The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of macromolecules to form a protein-containing complex.

ontology.comparison: Human CLDN1/O95832 and CLDN3/O15551 carry experimental IMP and IBA GO:0070830. CLDN19/Q8N6F1 has no exact matches. Performed target strand assembly, not comparator presence alone, supports the replacement.
ontology.structural_scope: Current structural descendants yielded no appropriate tight-junction-specific child. GO:0160187 enables selective paracellular transport and is not used for the standalone barrier.
ontology.process_scope: GO:0070830 refines the existing assembly assertion; it is not claimed to descend from GO:0065003. No NEW process is proposed.
